top_stories.title: BSP sees slim chance of 50-bp rate increase
top_stories.summary: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas is keeping the door open to a more aggressive 50-basis-point (bp) interest rate hike next month as policymakers assess a growing list of inflation risks, although BSP Governor Eli Remolona Jr. said such a move remains unlikely for now.
